failureCriteriaChecked: The gate would fail if material removal reduced the page to generic centred cards; the authored fan and other composition devices remained.
The gate would fail if two adjacent regions shared one composition family; the isolated skeleton retained the approved varied sequence.
The gate would fail if motion were inferred from canvas count; draw calls and changed pixels were measured.
The gate would fail if redaction produced apologetic blanks or damaged the operating-proof hierarchy; the in-page derivatives stayed legible and intentional.
The gate would fail if missing portrait media removed the quote or person; the source-unavailable plate preserved all testimonial meaning.
The gate would fail if static mode hid, cloned or truncated testimonials; it rendered exactly seven semantic list items with no clone track.

recommendation.reason: The isolated package preserves the already approved design while making its package identity, content boundaries, proof safety and fallbacks explicit.
